title: How long a password takes to crack

yt.title: An 8 letter password falls in {c_a_secs} seconds #Shorts
yt.description:
Computed: 26^8 lowercase combinations vs 94^12 for 12 random characters, at an assumed 10 billion guesses per second (a fast offline attack on a weak hash). Real systems vary.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.narration: An eight letter password, lowercase only, falls fast. Here is the math.

scenes.label: to try every 8 letter lowercase password
scenes.narration: There are about two hundred billion of them. At ten billion guesses per second, a fast offline attack tries them all in about {c_a_say} seconds.

scenes.label: for 12 random characters of every kind
scenes.narration: Twelve random characters, with letters, numbers, and symbols, would take about {c_b_say} years at the same speed. Length wins.
